Save a sonification as a sound file

Source: R/player.R
save_sound.Rd

The file type comes from the extension: .wav for plain audio, .mp3 for smaller files (needs the av package), or .mid for a MIDI file you can open in GarageBand, MuseScore or other music software.

Usage

save_sound(x, path)

Arguments

x

A sonification made by sonify_data().

path

Where to save it, like "season.wav".

Value

path, invisibly.

Examples

s <- sonify_data(data.frame(x = c(1, 5, 3)), x, instrument = "bell")
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".wav")
save_sound(s, path)
#> ✔ Saved /tmp/RtmpPdRcIy/file202d44ca7078.wav.
